name: No audio context exists before a press; the grid shows the authored pattern
A real press starts a running context with audible signal; playback writes no runtime and sends no event
Pause closes the context at once and schedules nothing further; one settled event says the cycle was heard
Cell presses toggle and persist; three quick edits settle as one event and the card does not move
Arrow keys move between cells and Space toggles the focused one without reaching the canvas
Tempo slider changes speed live and settles once on release
Starting a second sequencer silences the first: one live context
Switching documents while playing closes audio
A hidden tab (simulated visibilitychange) stops playback and returns to Reproducir
Panning the playing card out of view stops it
Refused activation (simulated NotAllowedError) is stated, keeps the grid editable, and Activar sonido retries
Reiniciar restores the authored pattern and tempo and stops sound
Dark theme and compact outline render the labelled grid
